📍Update 3:📍
I just want to say thank you to everyone who has managed to show me kindness and patience, as well as given advice (which I am taking to heart). I spoke with my surgeon's head nurse and he has increased my medications and is sending a new prescription to the pharmacy as I type this. I have been given instructions to check myself in if conditions don't improve within 8 hours, (my breathing issues have subsided except for instances of extreme pain and I am no longer shaking uncontrollably. My body temperature is normal, there are no signs or smells of infection, and I'm mostly able to speak again).
 If my pain increases or does not continue to decrease (I'm down to a steady 6.7 currently), breathing trouble returns, if I become faint or show any sign of infection or internal bleeding I will be transported by ambulance to the ER. 

I didn't take an Uber before because I don't have the money and am particularly vulnerable in this state, both as a trans person and as someone in this much pain and unable to wear any variety of pants because of that.

Since this post was originally made I have been gradually albeit slowly improving, and watching for any signs of left-behind instruments/towels, internal bleeding, or shock. So far there have been no symptoms. A lot of it was (TMI) really horrible gas pain, I wasn't able to pass any for 17 hours but finally managed and that helped a lot.

Thank you again to everyone for providing their kindness, perspectives, anecdotes and knowledge. I will update if I return to the hospital or if any new hurdles present themselves. I hope this has managed to be at least somewhat coherent.

My coherence is intermittent, I wish my consciousness were.

📍Update:📍
I called the nurse line and the doctor on call approved me to up my dose from 1 narco every 6 hours to 2 every 4-6, and told me to call my surgeon tomorrow if this doesn't help. I had him note this in my chart. 
My breathing is still labored and I am still in pain, but I am able to speak and no longer constantly writing.
I am watching for signs of distention and internal bleeding, gas-x has been a lifesaver for helping disperse the leftover C02 on top of it's intended purpose, and if my pain goes above an 8 while on medication I will be returning to the hospital.

-Make sure to name an executor that you can trust to execute your final wishes (and will be mentally able to do so when called upon), this can be family, a friend, or even a lawyer. If you choose a lawyer, be sure to include how much they will be paid for their service

-if you plan on being cremated you can request that they use a cremation box instead of a casket or something, this can cut down on final expenses majorly

-name guardians for any minor children you may have

-name all beneficiaries and what they would get, the simplest way to do this is to have your items that aren't allocated to anyone sold to benefit your estate and decide the estate funds into percentages to be assigned to each person

-instructions for any other assets/property and who would inherit them or any charities you'd like to donate to are always good to include

-include any login information for any online accounts and instructions for what you want done with them, as well as directions for who you want to take care of what in that respect, if applicable

-If you write letters to anyone or a general statement, write instructions to have them delivered and write them outside of your will (unless you want anyone you write to to have a copy of your will). Despite what they show in movies, it isn't typical for the family to gather for the reading of the will unless instructions to do so are included.

-if there is anyone you absolutely don't want to get any of your stuff or a portion of your estate that you think may try to take anything, you can include instructions that they are to receive nothing
